accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot

hypercore_slot_active.meaning: HyperCore has the 0x811 supplied-balance slot active (activated strict-read) after the accepted action
hypercore_slot_active.checkpoint: after the accepted action, before later Accountant reads

registered_slot_readable.meaning: every registered slot is an activated strict-read slot so Accountant backing reads can dereference it

total_backing_signed_reverts.meaning: later totalBackingSigned(), distributableSurplus(), and settleDailyPnL() revert until removeSuppliedEntry clears the entry
total_backing_signed_reverts.checkpoint: after supplyToBlp registration, before removeSuppliedEntry cleanup

assumptions: The Accountant backing reads dereference the registered BLP slot as described in the intent.
The reverting functions are invoked after supplyToBlp registers the slot and before removeSuppliedEntry clears it.

unresolved.description: Report states the inactive-slot outcome only as a possibility ("if the action is accepted but the slot remains unreadable"); the potential modality of the impact is preserved by treating the revert as a conditional scenario rather than an established prior state.

limitations: The impact is potential; the required_effect pattern encodes the conditional scenario, not an inevitable revert.
No numeric bounds or units are stated; all observables are qualitative Booleans.
Timing of HyperCore activation relative to notifyVaultSupply is unspecified beyond possible asynchrony.
